arguments.command:
python3 << 'PY'
# Data from Table FD-1 (Summary of Federal Debt)
# Total outstanding federal debt in millions of dollars

debt_1960 = 293100  # millions
debt_1961 = 295448  # millions
debt_1962 = 306128  # millions

# CPI-U annual averages (1982-84=100 base)
cpi_1960 = 29.6
cpi_1961 = 29.9
cpi_1962 = 30.2

# Adjust FY 1960 and FY 1961 to constant 1962 dollars
# Formula: Real = Nominal × (CPI_target / CPI_source)
real_1960 = debt_1960 * (cpi_1962 / cpi_1960)
real_1961 = debt_1961 * (cpi_1962 / cpi_1961)

print(f"FY 1960 nominal debt: ${debt_1960} million")
print(f"FY 1961 nominal debt: ${debt_1961} million")
print(f"FY 1962 nominal debt: ${debt_1962} million")
print()
print(f"CPI 1960: {cpi_1960}")
print(f"CPI 1961: {cpi_1961}")
print(f"CPI 1962: {cpi_1962}")
print()
print(f"FY 1960 adjusted to 1962 dollars: ${real_1960} million")
print(f"FY 1961 adjusted to 1962 dollars: ${real_1961} million")
print()

# Absolute difference
abs_diff = abs(real_1961 - real_1960)
print(f"Absolute difference (1961 - 1960): {abs_diff} million")

# Round to thousandths
abs_diff_rounded = round(abs_diff, 3)
print(f"Rounded to thousandths: {abs_diff_rounded}")

# Format without trailing zeros but with proper decimal places
formatted = f"{abs_diff_rounded:.3f}"
print(f"Final answer: {formatted}")
PY
